about: POST /api/guild/sync answers of the 0.6.0 panel. New fields: estado.mercados (per market of the upload: suben = members who uploaded in 14 days, aportan = persons who fed prices in 14 days, from GuildStore.freshness contributors/observers), subidor.ultima (newest uploader version the panel offers, the LATEST_UPLOADER constant), and markets[].sold (point samples stored by this upload). They are present on every 200 answer, duplicate included. 0.5.x uploaders ignore them; the 0.6.0 uploader must work without them (old panel). The marker takes the market entry with the most aportan (ties: the first by market name). Revision 2: quedan/dia = uploadsLeft and day of an accepted, non-duplicate answer that has both (old panels send them too); null = keep what the marker had (a duplicate answer has no uploadsLeft).
